newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh central bank governor fired.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh central bank governor fired.

text.p: Bangladesh's central bank governor, Khorshed Alam, was fired on Thursday for alleged irregularities and lack of control over subordinates, Finance Minister S.A.M.S. Kibria said.
"The governor has been relieved of his contract on the basis of an inquiry report," he told a news conference.
"The inquiry found that the governor had no control over his subordinates. Also he was found lenient about irregularities," a finance ministry official said.
The inquiry was launched in September, two months after the new government of Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina took office, he said without giving details.

Ministry officials said Alam, a retired bureaucrat who was appointed governor of the Bangladesh Bank nearly four years ago, was served with a notice on Wednesday to quit office. His contract was due to expire on December 19.
Alam was immediately replaced by Lutfar Rahman Sarkar, a career banker and the chief executive of a private sector bank.
